summary: PTY-host queue managers (`IpcQueueManager`/`PortQueueManager`) wedge into a perpetual pause loop because `clearQueue` releases internal maps but never calls `coordinator.resume(token)`, and the force-resume safety timeout deletes pause maps while leaving stale `queuedBytes`, so the next `addBytes` re-crosses the high watermark and instantly re-pauses.

title: POSIX 128+signum exit-code heuristic emits garbage signal strings for Windows NTSTATUS exit codes — gate on process.platform
summary: PtyHostLifecycle's UtilityProcess exit-code handling assumes the POSIX `128 + signum` convention when synthesizing signal strings for crash telemetry; on Windows the exit code carries a uint32 NTSTATUS value instead, so unguarded inference emits garbage signal strings (e.g. "SIG3221225349") and misclassifies large NTSTATUS crashes as SIGNAL_TERMINATED rather than UNKNOWN_CRASH. Gate the heuristic on process.platform.

title: Pin MCP help-session transports to their minting WebContents, never the focused window
summary: MCP renderer bridge (`rendererBridge.ts`) routes help-session tool calls through `getActiveProjectWebContents()`, the focused window, so a bearer minted by window A executes against whichever project view has focus — letting one project's assistant read and act on another's worktrees, terminals, and git state across the trust boundary. Pin dispatch to the minting WebContents instead.

title: Sidebar transition gating must cover the ResizeObserver→gridWidth path, not just PTY fit()/SIGWINCH
summary: Renderer grid layout: gating PTY/xterm resizes during a sidebar/focus-mode animation leaves React ResizeObservers that feed contentRect.width into setGridWidth→computeGridColumns ungated, re-snapping columns every frame; enumerate every geometry consumer (today: useContentGridContext.tsx + TwoPaneSplitLayout.tsx) via the module-level layoutTransitionLock.

title: Hover-reveal button clusters: opacity-0 + pointer-events-none stays in the Tab order — only visibility:hidden removes it
summary: Sidebar hover-reveal control clusters using `opacity-0 pointer-events-none` leave buttons in the keyboard Tab order while invisible, so keyboard users tab into unseen controls; `pointer-events: none` blocks mouse only, and removing focusability requires `visibility:hidden`.

title: Dock filter keyed off an async-set panel id leaks: pre-reserve the id synchronously before addPanel
summary: ContentDock's help-terminal filter keys off `helpPanelStore.terminalId`, which is set asynchronously after `addPanel`; for one render the freshly-spawned help terminal isn't excluded and leaks in as a real dock tile, so pre-reserve the id synchronously before adding the panel.

title: Inline buttons inside a dnd-kit sortable share its MouseSensor surface — subclass MouseSensor with a [data-no-dnd] opt-out, not a higher distance
summary: dnd-kit sortable cards in the worktree sidebar (`DndProvider`) share the card's `MouseSensor` drag-activation surface with inline interactive elements (popover triggers, dropdowns, badges, buttons); a sloppy click drifting past the 8px `activationConstraint` starts a drag instead of activating the button. Fix by subclassing `MouseSensor` to skip activation on `[data-no-dnd]` targets rather than raising the distance threshold.

title: Use visibilitychange (not beforeunload) to flush renderer-local dirty state on WebContentsView detach
summary: WebContentsView project views flush renderer-local Settings-dialog dirty state on detach using visibilitychange, not beforeunload/handleClose; ProjectViewManager's removeChildView detach never fires unload-style events, so unsaved env-var, worktree-pattern, and assistant tab edits are silently dropped on project switch.

title: MCP server readiness: httpServer.listening proves only socket-bound, not handler/auth/transport-ready — gate launch on a real initialize probe
summary: In-process MCP server readiness gating (McpServerService/httpLifecycle, HelpSessionService.ensureMcpServerReady): a `httpServer.listening` check confirms only socket binding, so handler-unwired, misconfigured-auth, or half-initialized-transport servers pass silently and the assistant terminal launches against an endpoint that hangs or 500s on its first request; gate on a real `initialize` probe instead.

title: Utility-process hosts must explicitly process.exit(1) on fatal errors — Electron 37+ warns instead of crashing, so the host lingers as a zombie
summary: PTY utility-process host (`electron/pty-host.ts`) under Electron 37+ does not auto-crash on `uncaughtException`/`unhandledRejection`—it only warns—so a host that logs but omits an explicit `process.exit(1)` lingers alive-but-broken, never triggering the parent's `child-process-gone` supervision and forcing ~90s `PtyHealthWatchdog` heartbeat-timeout recovery while the terminal appears frozen.

title: setTimeout-based TTL expiry stalls in hidden windows — sweep on visibilitychange against wall-clock expiresAt
summary: Trash TTL expiry in the Zustand panel registry (`scheduleTrashExpiry`, `src/store/slices/panelRegistry/trash.ts`) relies on a lone `setTimeout` that throttles/stalls while a project's `WebContentsView` is hidden, so soft-deleted terminals linger past their `expiresAt`; fix sweeps on `visibilitychange` against wall-clock `expiresAt`.

title: PtyEventRouter default branch silently drops PtyHostEvent variants that lack a case — no assertNever exhaustiveness guard
summary: PtyEventRouter.routeHostEvent (electron/services/pty/PtyEventRouter.ts) lacks an assertNever exhaustiveness guard, so PtyHostEvent union variants without an explicit case (e.g. fd-leak-warning) fall through to default, log "Unknown event type" and return false — silently dropping real host signals like fd-leak warnings.

title: Activity-hidden (keepMounted) dropdown bodies retain transient state — reset it in the effect setup, not on unmount
summary: FixedDropdown's keepMounted mode (React 19.2 `<Activity mode="hidden">`) preserves component state across open/close instead of unmounting, so transient indicators like a "copied" checkmark leak into the next reveal; reset such state in the effect that runs on each show, not in unmount cleanup.

title: Raising a base poll interval springs two latent traps: an uncapped multiplicative derived threshold and a value-equality default sentinel
summary: In WorktreeMonitor (workspace-host), raising base poll-interval constants springs two latent traps: a derived stale-detection threshold multiplied off the base (uncapped, blowing latency ~90s→15min) and a focus-change default that compares against the old constant by value-equality, silently reverting explicit recipe statusInterval overrides. Decouple derived/default logic from base-constant magnitude and exact value.

title: Windowed AND-gate activity classifiers are coupled to sample cadence — use a continuous-state leaky bucket for cadence invariance
summary: OutputVolumeDetector's fixed-window AND-gate (framesInWindow/bytesInWindow over windowMs) is coupled to ActivityMonitor's sample cadence: thresholds tuned at the 50ms foreground poll break at the 500ms background poll, where consecutive frames straddle the window boundary and pin frame counts at 1, trapping backgrounded agents in "waiting" (#6641, #1135, #4972). Use a continuous-state leaky bucket for cadence invariance.

title: Terminal create and hibernate-wake paths must share ONE listener-install function, never hand-roll the set twice
summary: Renderer xterm terminal-bound listeners (onData/fleet routing, observedTitle forwarding, Linux copy-on-select) were hand-rolled twice in getOrCreate() and unhibernate(), which drifted so the hibernate-wake path silently dropped three listeners; install them via one shared function instead.

title: git worktree list --porcelain keeps externally-deleted worktrees as 'prunable' (Git 2.31+) — prune before list/load and route ENOENT delete to prune
summary: WorkspaceService's `git worktree list --porcelain` reports externally-deleted worktrees (rm -rf, Finder) as 'prunable' entries (Git 2.31+), so phantom rows persist across refresh and restart and `git worktree remove` fails on the missing path; fix prunes before list/load and routes ENOENT-on-delete to prune.

title: Agent FSM was hand-duplicated across main process and renderer worker — copies drift silently because each context exercises only a subset of transitions
summary: The agent lifecycle FSM (nextAgentState over AgentEvent) was hand-duplicated in the main process AgentStateMachine and the renderer Web Worker (WorkerAgentStateService), and the copies silently drifted: the worker no-op'd completion/kill/respawn/watchdog-timeout events and had a wrong exit guard, producing incorrect agent states with no error. Share one transition function instead of duplicating it.

title: MCP destructive-action confirmation: use elicitation/create gated on capability negotiation, never the _meta-in-description bypass, and never silently fall back to the renderer modal once elicitation is chosen
summary: MCP server destructive-action confirmation (electron/services/mcp-server): the trap is relying on a model-honored _meta.confirmed convention embedded in tool descriptions/schemas instead of the negotiated elicitation/create protocol primitive, plus never silently falling back to the renderer modal after a decline. Repointed the now-removed buildToolDescription references to the inline bare entry.description set at sessionServer.ts:185.

title: Long-poll wait-for-idle must filter agent:state-changed by terminalId — agentId is the agent TYPE, shared across terminals
summary: The MCP terminal.waitUntilIdle long-poll subscribes to agent:state-changed but must match events by terminalId, not agentId — agentId is the agent TYPE (shared across terminals), so matching by agentId silently resolves a wait when a different terminal of the same agent finishes.

title: MCP tool annotations must derive from action kind, never the UX danger gate; overrides use ?? not || so explicit false survives
summary: In the MCP server's tierAuth `buildAnnotations`, derive MCP ToolAnnotations (especially `destructiveHint`) from the action's kind/semantics, not from `danger === "confirm"` — the danger gate only warns humans about token cost or UX risk, so reusing it flags read-only ops like `copyTree.generate` as destructive and pops false confirmation modals in clients. Apply per-action annotation overrides with `??` not `||` so an explicit `false` survives instead of being clobbered.

title: Flex-sibling promotion re-anchors an absolute child's containing block; two right-edge panels need a max() offset var, not a sum
summary: In AppLayout, promoting a panel from absolute-overlay to a flex sibling of `<main>` re-anchors any `position:absolute` child's containing block to `<main>` instead of the viewport, so the Portal dock stops at the Assistant's edge; and the shared `--portal-right-offset` var must use max(portalWidth, assistantWidth), not the sum, or right-edge popovers/toasts over-displace when both panels are open.

title: Claude Code .mcp.json headers don't honor ${VAR} — bake the literal bearer for Claude, env-var substitution for every other agent
summary: Generated MCP configs for the Daintree Assistant's launched CLIs must bake the literal bearer token for Claude Code's .mcp.json headers — Claude doesn't expand ${VAR} in header values, so the placeholder ships verbatim and every request 401s; other agents (Gemini/Codex/Copilot) do honor env-var substitution. Also: launching Claude with --strict-mcp-config silently disables the cwd-based session-dir discovery the config relies on.

title: Create-then-activate across two set() calls lets a reconciling watchdog prune the half-formed panel — fold the activation pointer into the panel commit
summary: In usePanelStore, creating a dock panel and setting activeDockTerminalId in two separate set() calls lets DockPanelOffscreenContainer's reconciling watchdog useEffect observe a transient state and prune the half-formed panel (popover snaps shut on creation); fold the activation pointer into the same set() commit as the panel.

title: Cold-start cache hydration needs a relaxed-TTL read separate from the strict polling TTL, plus a fresher-wins guard and a post-await identity re-verify
summary: GitHub stats pill cold-start hydration: reusing GitHubStatsCache.get()'s strict 10-minute MAX_CACHE_AGE_MS for seeding returns null and leaves the pill blank, so cache hydration needs a separate relaxed-TTL read plus a fresher-wins guard and post-await project-identity re-verify to avoid slow disk reads clobbering a fast poll or applying a stale project's stats after a mid-hydration switch.

title: Background git fetch: serialize per git-common-dir, set GIT_ASKPASS=true on POSIX, and bifurcate the 404 failure cache on prior-success
summary: Background git fetch in RepoFetchCoordinator/hardenedGit hits three headless-multi-worktree traps: concurrent fetches race on .git/packed-refs.lock (serialize per git-common-dir), credential helpers ignoring GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 hang on an invisible TTY prompt (set GIT_ASKPASS=true on POSIX), and an expired PAT returns 404 not 401/403 so a naive repo-not-found failure cache permanently hides a recovered token (bifurcate the cache on prior success).

title: Main→renderer IPC bounce must target the active project WebContentsView, pin the response sender, and fail closed on destroy
summary: MCP main-process IPC bounce to the renderer must target the active project WebContentsView, not BrowserWindow.webContents (the empty host shell under the per-project view architecture), or action-manifest/worktree/terminal tool calls resolve against host state and return empty/wrong results; the response path must also pin the sender and fail closed on view teardown to block spoofed resolves and hung promises.

title: Split Vite vendor chunks by dependency churn so V8 bytecode caches survive dep upgrades
summary: Vite renderer build splitting node_modules into a single catch-all vendor chunk invalidates the entire V8 bytecode cache (app:// codeCache, shared persist:daintree session) on any dependency bump, forcing full re-parse/recompile of byte-identical stable code like React/Radix at cold start. Split vendor chunks by churn rate to preserve the content-keyed cache.

title: PtyManager must buffer pre-spawn resizes and clear the buffer only after the TerminalProcess constructor succeeds
summary: PtyManager.resize silently drops dimensions when a renderer ResizeObserver resize IPC outraces the spawn IPC and the terminal isn't yet registered, booting the PTY at spawn-default size; fix buffers pre-spawn resizes and replays them once the TerminalProcess constructor succeeds.

title: Worktree create must pre-flight branch existence — reuse stale-but-uncheckout-out, suffix live-elsewhere; resolve batch branch names sequentially
summary: WorkspaceService.createWorktree must pre-flight branch existence: `git worktree add -b` fails with "branch already exists" when a worktree teardown left its branch behind, so reuse a stale-but-not-checked-out branch and suffix one that's live elsewhere. Bulk create must resolve batch branch names sequentially, not via Promise.all, or two siblings both claim the same free name and collide at write time.

title: useShallow compares one level deep — a Zustand selector returning a Record/object of objects still infinite-loops
summary: A Zustand `useShallow` selector that returns a Record/object-of-objects (e.g. `Record<paneId, {title, agentState}>`) still infinite-loops with "Maximum update depth exceeded" because `useShallow` only compares one level deep — nested object values are fresh references each tick. Split into per-pane primitive selectors instead of one nested-object selector.

title: Custom file protocol handlers: net.fetch reopens the path after realpath — close the TOCTOU with fs.open(O_NOFOLLOW) on the user-supplied path
summary: Custom file-protocol handlers (daintree-file:// in electron/setup/protocols.ts) carry a TOCTOU symlink-escape: realpath validates containment but net.fetch reopens and re-resolves the path independently, so swapping the final component for a symlink between check and fetch follows the link out of the sandbox; fix reads via fs.open(O_NOFOLLOW) on the user-supplied path and adds CSP/CORP/nosniff headers.

title: Trusted Types in the renderer needs BOTH a named policy and a pass-through 'default' policy, dual-layer CSP, and a lint ratchet
summary: Enforcing Trusted Types CSP (require-trusted-types-for 'script') in the Electron renderer breaks at runtime in third-party DOM sinks you don't control — React DOM and Radix Popper's SelectViewport inject raw strings into TT-gated sinks. A named policy for first-party innerHTML sites is insufficient; you also need a pass-through 'default' policy, dual-layer delivery (meta tag plus onHeadersReceived header), and a lint ratchet.

title: IPC payload size-gate: JSON.stringify byte-length is a type-unreliable wire-size proxy — detect-and-defer, don't estimate
summary: The IPC envelope size-gate (`validateIpcInvokeEnvelope` in `electron/setup/security.ts`) must not size payloads via `Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(args))`: JSON byte-length is a type-unreliable proxy for the structured-clone wire size, with per-type asymmetric failures (BigInt throws, undefined/functions vanish, Buffers/typed-arrays balloon or shrink) that let payloads crash the gate, silently bypass the budget, or get wrongly rejected. Detect-and-defer on unsizable types instead of estimating.

title: Localhost MCP server still needs DNS-rebinding defense, but must accept absent Origin headers — and the SDK's built-in protection is deprecated
summary: Daintree's loopback MCP server (electron/services/mcp-server/) still needs DNS-rebinding defense because browsers resolve hostile domains to 127.0.0.1 and POST to it; but Origin-allowlisting breaks legitimate non-browser clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Codex) that send no Origin header, the SDK's built-in rebinding protection is deprecated, and bearer-token checks must be constant-time to avoid leaking length/prefix via timing.

title: Cosmetic redraws are liveness evidence, not silence: strip protocol noise then count bytes, don't short-circuit
summary: In `ActivityMonitor.onData`, classifying spinner/status-line repaints as cosmetic and `return`-ing early before the byte-count debounce reset makes long-thinking agents (only emitting redraw frames) flip to `waiting` mid-thought; strip protocol noise and still count remaining bytes as liveness rather than short-circuiting.

title: Renderer event-loop sampling: LoAF observer in sandboxed preload, main-driven cadence (not renderer setInterval)
summary: Renderer ELU/Blink-memory telemetry across WebContentsViews — sandboxed preloads lack perf_hooks ELU so use a LoAF PerformanceObserver, and main drives the sampling cadence (active views only) because renderer setInterval is throttled in cached views. Repointed three stale windowServices.ts references to globalServicesInit.ts where sampleRendererElu/sampleBlinkMemory actually live.

title: External UtilityProcess watchdog for main-process deadlock — fail-open kill path + sleep/wake false-positive suppression
summary: External UtilityProcess watchdog (watchdog-host.ts / MainProcessWatchdogClient) for detecting deadlocked-main freezes that main can't self-recover from; the trap is false-positive SIGKILLs during normal long pauses (V8 major GC, sync better-sqlite3) and especially on system sleep/wake, plus the watchdog itself becoming a runaway restart loop — so the kill path must fail open and suppress wake false-positives.

title: Two-tier GPU crash recovery (ANGLE/Vulkan soft fallback → nuclear disable) needs flag-file loop guards and a 'never relaunch unless persist succeeded' rule
summary: Two-tier GPU crash recovery in electron/setup/environment.ts (soft ANGLE/Vulkan backend switch via relaunch, then nuclear hardware-accel disable) must guard against infinite relaunch loops with flag files and never relaunch unless recovery state persisted successfully, or read-only/permission-denied filesystems cause per-session loops. Also, gpuDetection.ts probing only /sys/class/drm renderD* nodes misses discrete GPUs exposed only via card* nodes on hybrid-GPU Wayland machines.

title: Plugin panel-kind registry needs an explicit cross-process event channel + useSyncExternalStore live map to hot-swap without reload
summary: The panel-kind registry (`shared/config/panelKindRegistry.ts` + `src/panels/registry.tsx`) is shared by source module, so each process/V8 context holds its own copy; mutating it to add or remove a plugin-contributed kind at runtime notifies no one and leaves panels stuck on `PluginMissingPanel` until a full reload. Hot-swapping needs an explicit cross-process event channel plus a `useSyncExternalStore` live map.

title: Action-system invariants must be CI asserts, not dev-mode console.warn — drift accumulates silently otherwise
summary: Action-system invariants (paired isEnabled/disabledReason, runtime keys matching the BuiltInActionId and KEY_ACTION_VALUES sets) must be hard CI assertions, not dev-mode console.warn — warnings scroll past unread, letting drift like 13 disabled-without-reason actions and a missing key-action entry accumulate silently across ActionService definition files.

title: MCP tool surface must be a default-deny curated allowlist, not the full action registry — too many tools degrade tool_choice accuracy and burn context
summary: The MCP ListTools handler must publish a default-deny curated allowlist instead of every non-restricted action in Daintree's ~308+ action registry; advertising the full ~380-tool surface degrades `tool_choice: "auto"` selection accuracy past ~50 tools and burns 60-90k input tokens of context per request before any work is done.

title: document.hidden gates launch INITIATION, never async-result COMMIT — it is transiently true during WebContentsView project switches
summary: In Daintree's per-project WebContentsView model, `document.hidden` is transiently true during project switches, so gating an in-flight `agent.launch` async COMMIT (e.g. storing the returned terminalId in helpPanelStore) on visibility silently discards the result; only gate launch INITIATION on visibility, never the result handler.

title: Closing Radix menu's FocusScope swallows keys in the next serial E2E test — gate on portal unmount, not focus or a fixed wait
summary: In serial Playwright E2E, a Radix DropdownMenu closed via Escape leaves its portal/FocusScope transiently mounted in document.body, so the next test's keystrokes are swallowed and never reach xterm/PTY even though focus assertions pass; gate on portal unmount rather than focus or a fixed wait.

title: Instant dropdowns: React.lazy still suspends with a resolved promise, and <Activity> reveal is indistinguishable from a filter change
summary: React.lazy still suspends for one render even with an already-resolved promise/cached chunk, flashing a skeleton on dropdown open; making code-split toolbar dropdowns feel instant needs layered fixes (preload chunk, prime data from the badge poll, keep body mounted across open/close) since `<Activity>` reveal is indistinguishable from a filter change and re-flashes rows on reopen.

title: Emitting tsc -b main tsconfig into esbuild's dist dir clobbers define-substituted bundle
summary: In the dual build pipeline (esbuild for main/preload bundles vs `tsc -b` typecheck), running `npm run check` after `npm run build` clobbers esbuild's define-substituted `main.js`/`bootstrap.js` in `dist-electron/electron` with tsc's plain transpile, dropping inlined defines (SENTRY_DSN, E2E-strip) so the app crashes only at launch, never at typecheck. Keep tsc emit out of esbuild's dist dir (noEmit/separate outDir).

title: A broadcast disk-pressure flag is inert until each writer opts in — gate tier-2 writes via the shared diskPressureState shim, never tier-1 session/config
summary: DiskSpaceMonitor's critical-pressure `writesSuppressed` flag is a renderer broadcast with no enforcement — main-process writers (telemetry/Sentry, file logger, GitHubStatsCache, ProjectStore frecency/lastOpened, SQLite) keep flushing unless each reads the shared diskPressureState shim; gate tier-2 writes through it but never tier-1 session/config.

title: Close producer MessagePorts before freezing/throttling a cached project view — consumer-side throttle doesn't stop upstream senders
summary: When ProjectViewManager freezes or CPU-throttles a cached per-project WebContentsView for LRU eviction, the consumer-side throttle doesn't halt upstream producers — main/workspace-host keep postMessage-ing into MessagePorts the frozen renderer can't drain, accumulating unbounded queued messages and OOMing. Close producer ports before freezing.

title: Unresponsive-renderer recovery: reload() hangs (waits for blocked unload handlers); use forcefullyCrashRenderer() to route into render-process-gone recovery
summary: Electron unresponsive-renderer recovery: the "Window Not Responding" dialog's reload() hangs indefinitely on a blocked renderer because reload waits for unhung unload handlers, so recovery depends on the broken event loop. Use forcefullyCrashRenderer() to route into the render-process-gone crash-recovery path instead.

title: Sandbox spawned-agent probe env with an allowlist (not denylist) plus output scrubbing — process.env leaks API keys to non-authenticating CLI probes
summary: Agent CLI probe spawners (AgentHelpService/AgentVersionService/AgentInstallService, WorktreeLifecycleService.buildSpawnEnv) passed full process.env to non-authenticating `--help`/`--version`/install children, leaking ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, AWS_*, GITHUB_TOKEN into child env and unscrubbed stdout/stderr surfaced to the renderer. Fix: allowlist env (not denylist) plus output scrubbing.

title: IPC error scrubbing must cover every wire field serializeError promotes (AppError.userMessage), not just serialized.message — and the scrub path only runs under app.isPackaged
summary: IPC error sanitizer in serializeError (shared/utils/ipcErrorSerialization.ts) scrubs only serialized.message, leaking secrets via AppError.userMessage and other whitelisted wire fields it promotes; the scrub path also runs only under app.isPackaged, so dev builds are never redacted. Scrub every promoted field, unconditionally.

title: files:read containment needs realpath + O_NOFOLLOW (not string-prefix) to close the final-component symlink TOCTOU
summary: The files:read IPC handler's symlink-containment guard used path.normalize + startsWith string-prefix matching, letting a renderer escape rootPath via an in-root symlink to secrets like ~/.ssh; close it with realpath plus O_NOFOLLOW (string-prefix and even canonicalization leave a final-component swap TOCTOU) and reject null-byte paths up front.

title: Never overlay an app CSP on a partition that hosts arbitrary remote origins (persist:browser)
summary: In setupWebviewCSP/classifyPartition (electron/setup/protocols.ts, webviewCsp.ts), the persist:browser session was wrongly assigned the localhost-only getLocalhostDevCSP, so its 'self'+localhost script-src/connect-src/form-action silently blocked all third-party CDN scripts, cross-origin fetch/XHR/WebSocket, and cross-origin form posts on remote sites. Never overlay an app/dev CSP on partitions hosting arbitrary remote origins.

title: @sentry/electron's default SentryMinidump integration leaks process.env secrets that beforeSend cannot scrub — filter it out at init
summary: @sentry/electron's default sentryMinidumpIntegration bypasses the beforeSend JS scrubber: native-crash .dmp payloads capture stack/register memory containing process.env secrets (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN passed to agent PTYs) and upload them, so TelemetryService must disable that integration at init rather than trust beforeSend.

title: PR CI indicator: 'no required checks' is not 'all checks passed' — fall back to the raw rollup, don't hardcode SUCCESS
summary: In the GitHub PR dropdown's CI indicator (deriveRequiredCIStatus, plugins/builtin/github/main/prRequiredCIStatus.ts), filtering statusCheckRollup to only isRequired===true contexts means repos with no branch protection (personal repos, forks) have zero required checks and always render green "No required checks" — masking actively failing or pending CI. Fall back to the raw rollup instead of hardcoding SUCCESS.

title: @xterm/headless 6.0: lowering options.scrollback actively evicts existing buffer lines (oldest first), not just caps future appends
summary: In @xterm/headless 6.0, lowering `Terminal.options.scrollback` retroactively evicts existing buffer lines (oldest first), not just caps future appends — this is what makes the pty-host ResourceGovernor's one-shot `trimBuffers()`/`trimScrollback()` pre-pause memory reclaim actually free resident memory; assuming it only caps future growth would make the trim-then-pause escalation a no-op.

title: Rolldown barrel optimization is experimental.lazyBarrel, not optimizeDeps.optimizePackageImports
summary: In the Vite 8 / Rolldown renderer build, barrel-package tree-shaking (lucide-react's 1,583 icon modules, eight @radix-ui packages) must use experimental.lazyBarrel, not optimizeDeps.optimizePackageImports — the latter is an esbuild-pre-bundle feature that is completely inert under Rolldown, leaving the full module graph (3,820 transformed modules) and its parse cost intact.

title: Fontconfig cache on Ubuntu CI runners: stale/partial cache causes flaky Skia SIGILL/SIGTRAP, not just slow cold start
summary: On Ubuntu CI, a missing or partially-written ~/.cache/fontconfig doesn't just slow cold renderer startup — a corrupt cache triggers intermittent Skia SIGILL/SIGTRAP crashes that surface as flaky E2E failures with no JS stack, misleading you into chasing Chromium GPU flags or swrast instead of pre-warming the font cache.

title: Animating grid panel reflow needs FLIP (not CSS grid transitions), and the FLIP transform must integer-snap and not fight dnd-kit
summary: Animating ContentGrid panel reflow on column-count changes requires FLIP, not a `transition: grid-template-columns` (which animates track sizes while items teleport); and because each SortableTerminal's dnd-kit `useSortable` also writes `style.transform`, the FLIP transform must integer-snap and cede transform control during drag to avoid jitter.

title: Tailwind v4 dropped the animate-in/fade-in/zoom-in/slide-in utilities — Radix overlay wrappers silently lose all open/close animation without tw-animate-css
summary: The shadcn-style Radix overlay wrappers in src/components/ui/ (popover, dropdown, context-menu, select, tooltip) lose all open/close motion after the Tailwind v3→v4 migration because v4 dropped the built-in animate-in/fade-in/zoom-in/slide-in utilities; class names still resolve to nothing with no build error, lint failure, or console warning, so add tw-animate-css and only catch it on visual review.

title: Tailwind v4 outline-none emits outline-style:none and kills forced-colors focus rings — use outline-hidden
summary: Tailwind v4 `outline-none` compiles to `outline-style:none`, silently killing keyboard focus indicators in forced-colors/Windows High Contrast mode where the UA strips the `ring-*`/box-shadow fallback too; use `outline-hidden` to preserve the UA focus ring on suppressed-outline interactive elements.

title: Reduced-motion `transition/animation: none !important` kills Radix Presence unmount, ghosting closed popovers/menus in the DOM
summary: Reduced-motion suppression in src/index.css (OS prefers-reduced-motion and the in-app data-reduce-animations toggle) blanket-applied transition: none !important to broad button selectors, killing Radix Presence's exit transition so closed popovers/dropdowns stay mounted — ghosting in the DOM, holding focus/aria, and blocking pointer events behind them.

title: WebGL context-loss recovery needs a sliding-window circuit breaker, and the breaker must coalesce per-frame eviction bursts
summary: TerminalWebGLManager's GPU context-loss recovery keeps faulting terminals in `wants`, so on persistent faults (M-series Macs on fractional-scaled external displays emitting GL_INVALID_OPERATION) reacquisition re-faults forever, strobing between WebGL and DOM. Needs a sliding-window circuit breaker that coalesces per-frame eviction bursts.

title: Pin core.precomposeunicode=true in hardened git so macOS emits NFC paths, not NFD — git-derived paths otherwise compare unequal to NFC paths everywhere else
summary: The hardened SimpleGit factory (electron/utils/hardenedGit.ts SAFE_GIT_CONFIG) must pin core.precomposeunicode=true so macOS git emits NFC paths; without it git status returns NFD-decomposed filenames that fail bitwise === against NFC paths from every other source, silently breaking React list keys and WorktreeMonitor previousStateHash equality.

title: Stacked frontend+backend cache TTLs sum, and a SUCCESS-skip re-enrichment guard froze the stale-green CI tick permanently
summary: GitHub PR CI-tick subsystem: stacked renderer-over-backend cache TTLs sum to worst-case staleness, and a monotonic "skip re-enrich when already SUCCESS" guard froze a stale-green tick into a permanent fixed point. Repointed regression-test citation from the deleted GitHubService.adversarial.test.ts to the plugin tests, and noted the guard is now correctly keyed on ciSummary === undefined.

title: OS-native picker windows (input type=color → NSColorPanel) steal focus and trip Radix DismissableLayer; keep all interaction in-DOM
summary: In Radix Popover-based pickers (PresetColorPicker), triggering an OS-native chooser like `<input type="color">` opens a separate floating window (NSColorPanel) that steals focus and trips Radix DismissableLayer, instantly closing the popover on first click; keep all picker interaction in-DOM rather than delegating to OS-native windows.

title: contextBridge strips Error name+code a SECOND time after IPC deserialize — smuggle the AppError discriminant in the message prefix
summary: AppError IPC propagation crosses two strip boundaries, not one: after serializeError/deserializeError (lesson #3769) re-attaches `code` on a fresh Error at main→preload, the preload→renderer contextBridge realm boundary strips custom Error props plus `name` AGAIN, so renderer `e.code` discriminant checks break — workaround smuggles the AppErrorCode discriminant in the message prefix.

title: Don't nest a JSON string inside a JSON config — store native arrays with permissive-read/strict-write Zod and lazy migration
summary: Persisting electron-store config fields as JSON.stringify'd strings nested inside the already-JSON config (e.g. terminal/theme customSchemes) creates a double-encoding chain where any escaping slip silently drops the whole entry; the read path's try/JSON.parse/catch-return-[] swallows the loss. Store native arrays with permissive-read/strict-write Zod and lazy migration instead.

title: Partition persisted state by write frequency — high-churn window bounds must not share an electron-store file with user settings
summary: electron-store (electron/store.ts) rewrites the entire config.json on every set, so high-frequency window resize/move saves in electron/windowState.ts each open a corruption window (crash, AV lock, Dropbox/iCloud sync race) that can truncate the file; partition high-churn window bounds into a separate store so a window drag can't destroy themes, keybindings, and settings.

title: Two persistence stores for recipes (.daintree/ git-tracked vs userData recipes.json) drift into split-brain; reconcile on load with one canonical source
summary: Recipe persistence splits across two stores — git-tracked .daintree/recipes/{name}.json (inrepo-scoped ids, sanitized) and machine-local userData recipes.json (runtime fields, env secrets, lastUsedAt) — which drift into split-brain: deleting from one store lets the other resurrect it on next project load, and stale recipes.json entries shadow or duplicate the in-repo copy. Fix reconciles both against one canonical source on load.

title: Fire-and-forget IPC (`void window.electron.X()`) needs a synchronous call-site stack snapshot, not a global rejection handler
summary: Renderer fire-and-forget IPC (`void window.electron.X()`) rejections vanish silently or surface with only Electron's IPC-plumbing stack, since the original call site is gone by the time the global `unhandledrejection` handler fires; capture a synchronous call-site stack snapshot at the fire site instead of relying on a global rejection handler.

title: Bulk-spread slice writes to electron-store bake in first-launch defaults; use dot-path writes — but not for records with dotted keys
summary: In electron-store settings (electron/store.ts), the spread-write pattern `store.set("slice", {...store.get("slice"), field})` persists the entire defaulted slice to config.json, freezing first-launch defaults so later code changes to those defaults are silently ignored for existing users; use dot-path writes instead, except for records whose keys themselves contain dots.

title: Compile-time ban on {ok|success} handler return shapes; the distributive-union trap and self-documenting branded errors
summary: Electron IPC handlers that signal failure by returning `{ok|success: false, error}` get silently swallowed: `wrapSuccess` in security.ts nests the failure inside an `ok:true` envelope, so the preload unwrapper reads it as success. Compile-time ban on these handler return shapes plus the distributive-union trap and branded errors.

title: fix(fs): fsync parent directory after atomic write rename
summary: In the atomic-write utility (electron/utils/fs.ts), fsyncing the file plus an atomic rename is NOT durable — the rename's directory entry can stay in volatile cache, so a crash leaves the target existing but null/stale; you must also fsync the parent directory after rename, with win32 skip and POSIX EPERM/EINVAL tolerance.

title: Markered login-shell env probe: stderr MUST be ignored (not piped) or oh-my-zsh deadlocks the closing marker, and random-hex markers strip prompt-tool noise from the env dump
summary: PR #6098's environment-resolution shell probe (electron/setup/environment.ts) spawns $SHELL -i -l -c to read the user's real PATH; the trap is that piping stderr deadlocks the child once a chatty .zshrc fills the OS pipe buffer (must be stdio "ignore"), and interactive-shell stdout must be parsed only between random-hex markers to discard Powerlevel10k/oh-my-zsh/motd noise. It also sets ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 deliberately (inverse of #4232) so the Electron binary dumps env as Node without depending on a not-yet-resolved PATH.

title: DisposableStore is the canonical main-process cleanup primitive — disposal runs in registration order, late add() disposes immediately, and that ordering is a load-bearing contract
summary: PR #6092 introduced electron/utils/lifecycle.ts (DisposableStore/MutableDisposable, ported from VS Code) as the main-process teardown primitive. The non-obvious traps: disposal runs in registration order (so pvm.dispose() must be registered before window services so views close before their MessagePorts), add-after-dispose disposes immediately instead of silently leaking, and snapshot-before-iterate plus _isDisposed-first make re-entrant/throwing children safe.

title: A top-level `export const store = initializeStore()` runs Store construction at import time — before app.setPath("userData") in dev
summary: Main-process store singleton trap: exporting `const store = initializeStore()` at module top level runs electron-store's userData-reading constructor at import time, which races (and loses) against dev's `app.setPath("userData")`; the fix moves init to an explicit idempotent bootstrap call and keeps call-site ergonomics via a lazy-initializing, method-binding Proxy.

title: webContents.close() does not remove JS listeners — detach persistent handlers before close() or queued Chromium events fire against an evicted view
summary: ProjectViewManager eviction trap: webContents.close() leaves persistent wc.on listeners attached, so a queued did-finish-load/render-process-gone can fire after eviction and act on stale views/activeProjectId — fix detaches named handlers via an idempotent cleanupHandlers() closure before close().

title: fix(hardening): utilityProcess.fork env REPLACES process.env — Linux node-pty io_uring hang fix must live inside the explicit env object
summary: utilityProcess.fork's env option fully replaces the parent process.env rather than merging, so any child env var (the Linux node-pty io_uring hang workaround UV_USE_IO_URING=0, locale, CA bundles) must be set inside the explicit env literal in PtyHostLifecycle — a process.env mutation never reaches the forked PTY/workspace host.

title: Exit code 127 is invisible to node-pty.onExit for interactive shells — command-not-found detection must parse (localized) output
summary: IdentityWatcher gates agent-badge demotion on a "command failed" signal; the intuitive POSIX exit-code-127 fix is invisible to node-pty.onExit for interactive shells (the shell stays alive), so detection must parse output — and that output is locale-dependent, requiring localized phrase patterns plus locale-independent PowerShell anchors.

title: Preserve recovery backup when electron-store wipes a schema-invalid config
summary: In electron-store startup recovery (`electron/store.ts`), a JSON-valid but schema-invalid config slips past `preflightValidateConfig`, so the `new Store({clearInvalidConfig})` constructor silently resets it to defaults, then the unconditional `refreshBackup` copies the defaulted file over `.bak`, destroying the last recoverable state with no error or log.

title: Per-WebContents IPC must return null for unbound views, never fall back to the global current project
summary: In the multi-window project-scoping subsystem, a per-WebContents IPC handler (project:get-current) leaked the last-active project into unbound new windows by falling back to the process-global projectStore.getCurrentProject() when the sender had no ProjectViewManager binding. The fix: absence of a binding resolves to null (renderer shows WelcomeScreen), now generalized in resolveScopedProjectForIpcContext.

title: Idempotent PTY teardown via illegal-transition no-op, and the singleton terminal:exited event must be scoped by spawnedAt session token
summary: In the PTY lifecycle subsystem, multi-entry teardown is made idempotent by gating on a state-machine transition that returns false on illegal progression (no boolean to keep in sync), and the process-wide terminal:exited event must be filtered by both terminalId AND the spawnedAt session token — otherwise a late stale exit from a respawn-under-same-id hijacks the new instance's one-shot listener.

title: Safe-mode needed before the crash-loop guard initializes: add a stateless sentinel reader, don't init the mutating guard early
summary: In Daintree's Electron boot path, the safe-mode predicate is needed in bootstrap.ts (before main.ts initializes CrashLoopGuardService), and the trap is that the stateful isSafeMode() getter is only valid after initialize() — which mutates the sentinel — so the fix is a stateless, side-effect-free isSafeModeActive() reader, not an early initialize() call.

title: Ephemeral renderer-only agent states need an owner-independent escape path — a debounce timer that doesn't survive rehydration leaves the state permanently stuck
summary: The terminal `directing` agent state was a renderer-only ephemeral state cleared solely by a per-instance debounce timer; once persisted and rehydrated (project switch, LRU eviction, hot reload, wake) no timer tracked it and an IPC guard blocked external clearance, leaving the indicator stuck forever. Fix: exclude it from serialization plus an owner-independent stale sweep on attach/wake and a wall-clock guardrail swept on visibilitychange (defeating Chromium IntensiveWakeUpThrottling).

title: WebGL 'wants' must track the visible fleet, not the open fleet — release off-screen, restore after reparent
summary: In the count-based WebGL mode switch, TerminalInstanceService's setVisible() is the consumer that defines the "wants" set, so it must drop/re-add membership on IntersectionObserver visibility (not just tier) or the count reflects open panels and never recovers; the trap is the asymmetric debounce plus the post-attach reparent reconciliation that re-arms the lease after setVisible(true) early-returns on isAttaching.

title: Renderer jank attribution: prefer long-animation-frame over longtask (script source, incompatible observe shape, lib-dom drift)
summary: The renderer jank probe (src/utils/longTaskMonitor.ts) moved from longtask (no attribution, name always "self") to long-animation-frame with PerformanceScriptTiming — but the LoAF API needs the single-type+durationThreshold observe shape (not entryTypes:[]) and local declare-global stubs because TS lib.dom lags Chromium 146.

title: Agent-ness is dynamic runtime state of a terminal, not a persisted panel kind — model it on agentId, never a discriminator
summary: PR #5801 collapsed the persisted "agent" panel kind into "terminal", relocating agent-ness onto agentId/detectedAgentId because it is transient runtime state of a PTY pane, not a structural discriminator. The lesson captures the modeling rule plus two surviving traps: TerminalRuntimeIdentity.kind is a separate non-persisted "kind" field, and inferAgentIdFromTitle deliberately still keys on the legacy marker to avoid silently re-promoting renamed shells.

title: Runtime agent promotion is spawn-sealed — only renderer-side xterm policies are repairable, never the PTY child env
summary: In the terminal-agent-promotion subsystem, when AgentPatternDetector promotes a plain-spawned terminal to host an agent, only renderer-side xterm policies (scrollback, cursor-blink, WebGL) can be repaired in-process via applyAgentPromotion; the PTY child env is spawn-sealed and can only reach parity through a user-initiated convertTerminalType respawn, never a silent env patch or transparent respawn.

title: Terminal identity splits into persisted launch hint vs non-persisted runtime detection — never let runtime identity reach project JSON
summary: Terminal identity must be modeled as two fields with opposite persistence rules: persisted launchAgentId (restart hint) vs non-persisted detectedAgentId (live runtime); guard the no-persist invariant at serializer/hydration/exit-clear. Repointed three moved paths: narrowDetectedAgentId (electron/pty-host/handlers/terminalInfo.ts), exit-clear reduceAgentExited (src/store/listeners/panel/identityReducer.ts), reconnect merge (src/store/slices/panelRegistry/addPanel.ts).

title: Terminal preservation must key on a sticky runtime-detected flag, not the spawn-time isAgentTerminal classification
summary: PTY terminal preservation (shouldPreserveOnExit) keyed on the spawn-time isAgentTerminal flag, silently trashing plain terminals that ran an agent mid-session; the fix is a sticky everDetectedAgent boolean threaded through every snapshot/pty-host/reconnect/statePatcher path and merged with || so process-boundary races never downgrade it.

title: Restart must read runtime state, not persisted launch identity — a demoted agent panel relaunches the agent unless every agent field is cleared
summary: Panel restart subsystem: restartTerminal classified agent-vs-shell from persisted launch identity, so a panel where the user quit the agent to a shell relaunched the agent on restart; the fix gates on dual runtime death signals and clears every agent field because the IPC spawn handler re-derives agent-ness from type/agentId, not kind.

title: fix(ProcessDetector): hysteresis gate is bypassed by the busy/command side-channel and by mid-window teardown
summary: ProcessDetector's agent-identity hysteresis gate was defeated because the busy/command fields on the same DetectionResult callback emit on independent predicates, and an OFF streak in flight at stop() left ghost UI. The lesson: a gate must cover every emission path sharing the sink (without advancing the comparison baseline during suppression), and in-flight streaks must be flushed on teardown.

title: Never gate a component's mount on a signal its own mount effect produces
summary: In the overlay/mount-gate subsystem (AppLayout + useOverlayClaim/useUIStore overlayStack), using an effect-registered overlay claim as the gate for mounting the component that registers it creates a self-referential deadlock — the gate is only set by the child it is supposed to mount. Fix: gate on ancestor/external store state (themeBrowserStore.isOpen) and reserve the post-mount claim for sibling inert/scrim.

title: Multiplexing broadcast IPC onto one events:push channel needs a ref-counted single-listener dispatcher and a bus-vs-external double-emission guard
summary: The IPC event-bus subsystem multiplexes many main->renderer broadcasts onto a single events:push envelope channel; the trap is that a per-helper ipcRenderer.on trips Node's 10-listener MaxListenersExceededWarning and that window-scoped "external" events must not also be relayed by the TypedEventBus bridge or they double-deliver. Fix is one ipcRenderer.on with a ref-counted Map<name,Set<cb>> dispatcher plus a satisfies-enforced bus/external manifest.

title: git rev-list --max-parents=0 returns the grafted boundary in a shallow clone, not the historical root
summary: ProjectPulseService derives first-commit date from rev-list --max-parents=0, but in a shallow clone that returns the grafted boundary SHA instead of the true root, poisoning isBeforeProject culling and blanking the heatmap. Probe rev-parse --is-shallow-repository and bail to a safe no-cull fallback.

title: Forked utility processes inherit the main process's dead fd 2 on GUI launch — pipe stdio and swallow EIO/EBADF, not just EPIPE
summary: In the utility-process spawn layer (WorkspaceHostProcess), forking with stdio:"inherit" couples the child's survival to the parent's fd 2, which is a dead/orphaned pty on AppImage/Wayland GUI launches; the dominant errno there is EIO/EBADF, not EPIPE, so single-errno guards crash invisibly outside dev. Fix: fork with stdio:"pipe" + logger forwarding and widen the dead-fd guard.

title: Read-only host capabilities backed by a late-injected service need a pending-subscription replay queue, a re-check-after-await dispose guard, and an explicit no-spread freeze projection
summary: PluginService exposes read-only worktree state to plugins backed by a WorkspaceClient that is injected after plugins activate — the trap is that activation order forces a pending-subscription replay queue, every read crosses an async boundary the unload path can interleave with (re-check this.plugins.has after await), and the internal snapshot must be allowlist-projected by explicit field assignment then frozen (no spread, deep-clone nested) to avoid leaking/mutating host state.

title: Hydration drops unregistered panel kinds by policy — disabled-plugin panels need a pluginId/dotted-kind escape hatch, stamped at creation
summary: Panel hydration/persistence: the unregistered-kind skip predicate is a policy that must carry a recoverability discriminator (pluginId or dotted kind) so disabling a plugin hides rather than permanently deletes its panels. Repointed the creation-time pluginId stamp from the removed core.ts location to addPanel.ts (:176 non-PTY, :327 PTY) and dropped the nonexistent gridPanelPropsAreEqual comparator — GridPanel uses plain React.memo over terminalId and re-subscribes via the store, so the field rides the Zustand subscription, not a prop.

title: Removing a built-in panel kind leaves dead kinds in persisted layouts — hydration must distinguish removed-built-in (skip silently) from missing-plugin (show placeholder) by dotted-vs-non-dotted kind name
summary: Panel-hydration trap: deleting a built-in panel kind (notes) is incomplete without a guard in panelRestorePhase.ts, because saved layouts still carry the dead kind and the unregistered-kind branch must split three ways — removed built-in (bare token, skip) vs missing plugin (has pluginId) vs legacy plugin (dotted kind name), restoring placeholders only for the latter two.

title: Plugin actions: handler stays in main as a synthetic renderer ActionDefinition that IPC-bounces; the startup validator must read the live registry, and register-before-import
summary: Foundational plugin runtime-action registry: a plugin's handler can't cross IPC, so the renderer reconstitutes a synthetic ActionDefinition whose run() bounces back via plugin:invoke; the startup unknown-action validator must merge the live pluginService.listPluginActions() set (not a BUILT_IN_ACTION_IDS snapshot), and PluginService must insert the plugin into its map before importing the plugin's main module.

title: Plugin host API needs a dual-liveness model — revoke registration surfaces after activate(), gate runtime surfaces on plugin membership
summary: PluginService's host API (createHost/revoke + runActivate timeout) must split methods by liveness: activation-only surfaces (registerHandler, broadcastToRenderer, registerAction) hard-throw via a revoked flag, while lifetime surfaces (showToast, dispatch, logger) silently no-op on plugin-membership checks; plus PluginIpcContext keeps the raw IpcMainInvokeEvent/BrowserWindow out of plugin reach.

title: MediaRecorder onstop races the last async ondataavailable chunk — finalize on a drain barrier, not onstop
summary: Demo screen-capture pipeline (DemoCaptureBridge + demo.ts handler): MediaRecorder's onstop fires before the final ondataavailable chunk's async arrayBuffer()/IPC send completes, so finalizing on onstop truncates the WebM — must gate finalization on a pendingChunks drain barrier. Also covers the Electron getDisplayMedia trap: setDisplayMediaRequestHandler with useSystemPicker:false on the renderer's session partition.

title: Window bootstrap must bind from per-window initialProjectId, never the global current-project singleton
summary: In multi-window Electron, setupWindowServices bootstrapped each new window from the global projectStore.getCurrentProjectId() singleton instead of per-window opts.initialProjectId, so Cmd+N inherited the last-focused window's project; the trap is reading a focus/recency global during per-window init and the fix requires an explicit unbind (setActiveProject(win.id, null)) for unbound windows.

title: Push runtime config to a utility-process host on its "ready" event, not at fork — and cache it for restart replay
summary: In Daintree's utility-process clients (PtyClient/WorkspaceHostProcess), pushing config to a forked host at spawn time silently drops it because the child's port.on("message") listener attaches only after it emits "ready"; the fix caches the value, replays it from the "ready" handler on every ready (spawn + restart), seeds from the persisted store for early-boot spawns, and keeps the handler's deps live (no destructured snapshot) so late-assigned services still receive the fan-out.

title: Main-process deferred-init queue: arm the drain trigger before any await, and never trust the happy-path signal alone
summary: The main-process deferred-init queue (electron/window/deferredInitQueue.ts) is gated on a best-effort renderer first-interactive signal; the trap is that drainability is a separate lifecycle phase from registration, the signal can be lost, and setImmediate drain chains can corrupt a reset queue.

title: Writing one key of a nested Record field through an entry-shallow-merge store action clobbers all sibling keys
summary: Daintree's agent-settings store persists entries via a shallow `{ ...prev, ...updates }` merge in `updateAgent`, so writing a single key of the nested `worktreePresets` Record directly would replace the whole submap and silently wipe every other worktree's saved preset; the fix is a dedicated read-spread-write action (`updateWorktreePreset`).

title: Eager-import budget gate models main-process startup cost as a metafile graph walk — stop at dynamic-import edges, mirror the real build's externals, ratchet by file-path allowlist
summary: The scripts/import-budget CI ratchet defines "eager startup cost" as a static BFS over the esbuild metafile from electron/main.ts (stopping at dynamic-import edges, skipping externals); the traps are that the budget build must mirror build-main.mjs's external/define/target, the file-path allowlist (not the syncViolations snapshot) is the sole gate, and the renderer counterpart walks Vite chunk keys to avoid double-counting Rolldown groups.

title: A fire-and-forget poll loop needs a tracked promise + abortable sleep to have a real teardown contract
summary: CcrConfigService's 30s config-watch loop was fire-and-forget, so stopWatching() returned before an in-flight loadAndApply()+broadcast finished, leaving teardown undefined. The durable fix is the service-internal contract: track the loop promise, make stop() async and await it, use an abortable sleep, and snapshot+null the controller/promise locals before aborting to survive a racing start().

title: fix(git): stabilise internal git env for locale and SSH first-connect
summary: Headless git in Daintree's hardenedGit factories must defeat three independent surfaces: git's credential TTY, ssh's separate host-key first-connect TTY (GIT_SSH_COMMAND with StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new + BatchMode=yes), and stderr language (LC_MESSAGES=C, only effective once LC_ALL is cleared) so stderr-regex classifiers don't silently misfire on non-English machines.

title: Honour GitHub rate limits at the fetch layer — Octokit v9 strips Response headers, and stale cross-process block events must not reblock after a token rotation
summary: GitHub rate-limit honoring (GitHubRateLimitService / GitHubAuth fetch wrapper): @octokit/graphql v9 drops the raw Response before resolving, so headers must be observed via a custom fetch wrapper with two-phase (header-then-body) classification, and cross-process block propagation must suppress stale exhausted-quota events that predate a credential rotation.

title: noUncheckedIndexedAccess turns every index access into T | undefined — capture the value in a local guard, don't blanket-! it
summary: TypeScript build/tsconfig: enabling noUncheckedIndexedAccess widens every array/record index to T | undefined and doesn't narrow across separate index expressions — bind the indexed value to a local and guard that, only !-assert under a length/modulo bound.

title: PtyClient.spawn() is void and reports outcome via a spawn-result event that can fire synchronously — await the event, attached before the call
summary: errorHandlers.ts terminal-retry path: PtyClient.spawn() returns void and signals via a spawn-result event that the cap guard emits synchronously, so the listener must be attached before the call; carrying error.code lets the retry classifier mark PENDING_SPAWNS_CAPPED non-auto and skip backoff.

title: fix(terminal): use leaky-bucket rate limit for spawn to unstall batch flows
summary: In electron/ipc/utils.ts, waitForRateLimitSlot picks between a strict-interval leaky bucket (2-arg) and a sliding window (3-arg) by arity alone, so a batch-tolerant spawn path that passed the 3-arg form silently got step-function stalls every N spawns; the fix swaps to the 2-arg leaky form for smooth cadence.

title: typedHandle IPC layer: never return {ok|success} from a handler, and keep the perf wrapper's sync fast-path
summary: The typed IPC handler wrapper (electron/ipc/utils.ts) has two traps: a handler that returns its own {ok|success} envelope is double-wrapped and silently surfaces as success in the renderer (compile-blocked by ForbidIpcEnvelopeKeys), and the perf-tracing path must branch on isPerformanceCaptureEnabled() to preserve a synchronous fast-path or it converts sync handlers to async.

title: Batch async store appends by splitting eager lookup-map from deferred fanout array
summary: Panel-registry hydration batching: N async addPanel calls each fire a Zustand set() across await boundaries (React 19 auto-batching can't coalesce, Zustand 5 has no batch API), so the fix splits the commit — eager panelsById for live by-id event-listener lookups, deferred panelIds append at flush to collapse N high-fanout renders/persists into one, gated by a module-level token singleton.

title: UtilityProcess crash classification: exit fires BEFORE child-process-gone — defer one tick to consume the authoritative reason, never the exit-code heuristic
summary: In Electron 37-41 the UtilityProcess `exit` event fires before `app.on("child-process-gone")`, so classifying a PTY/workspace host crash synchronously in the exit handler always falls back to the unreliable exit-code heuristic; the fix stashes the authoritative gone reason and consumes it via a one-tick setImmediate defer. Now canonical host-supervision shape in PtyHostLifecycle.ts and WorkspaceHostProcess.ts.

title: Agent respawn has THREE command-derivation paths — fixing resume doesn't fix the no-session fallbacks
summary: In the agent state-hydration respawn/restart subsystem, persisting agentLaunchFlags fixed only the resume branch; the no-session and resume-unavailable fallback branches silently re-derived the command from current settings, dropping per-terminal flags. The lesson covers the three-path trap and the static-vs-runtime-dynamic flag re-injection (Gemini --include-directories) handled by the new buildLaunchCommandFromFlags.

title: Save path erases plugin-kind fields when no serializer is registered — fall back to the previous snapshot, not an empty fragment
summary: In the panel persistence save path (src/store/persistence/panelPersistence.ts), an unregistered kind serializer caused panelToSnapshot to emit a base-only snapshot, silently erasing previously-persisted kind-specific fields on the next save/project-switch — the fix threads the previous snapshot through so transiently-unregistered (plugin/extension) kinds are preserved instead of clobbered.

title: pendingSpawns is a crash-replay buffer, not just a tracking map — cap admission (hard) but keep pendingKillCount soft (clear-on-respawn)
summary: PtyClient's pendingSpawns map doubles as the crash-recovery replay buffer (respawnPending re-sends every entry on host restart), so leaving it unbounded turns one host crash into a self-amplifying restart storm; the fix is a hard admission cap with a !has(id) carve-out for replays, while the sibling pendingKillCount stays a soft cap because clear-on-respawn is its real defense.

title: Lazy-load the migrations barrel behind a schema-version gate — a surviving static import defeats the code-split
summary: In the electron-store migration startup path, gating the migrations barrel behind a hand-maintained LATEST_SCHEMA_VERSION constant only code-splits if every static import is removed; the gate must be answerable without loading the module, and the drift-guard test must vi.mock("electron") because the barrel touches electron.app at load time.

title: Full-jitter restart backoff needs a floor or an instant-fail crash busy-spins the CPU
summary: The PTY host auto-restart backoff in electron/services/pty/PtyHostLifecycle.ts replaced deterministic exponential backoff with AWS full jitter, but full jitter alone can return a near-zero delay that busy-spins the CPU when the host fails synchronously on fork — the load-bearing insight is the 100ms floor under the jitter plus a disposed/already-respawned guard re-checked at timer-fire.

title: webFrame.setZoomFactor is Blink layout zoom — animating it per-frame rebuilds the xterm WebGL atlas every frame
summary: Animating webFrame.setZoomFactor per-frame in the main renderer is Blink layout zoom: it changes DPR and rebuilds the xterm @xterm/addon-webgl TextureAtlas every frame (blanking/snap); use CSS transform: scale() instead, as DemoCursor.tsx now does.

title: Surface utility-host crashes fast on the renderer side: MessagePort `close` is the authoritative transient signal; the parallel IPC broadcast carries only the one thing the port can't — `fatal` (no replacement coming)
summary: WorktreePortClient (electron/preload.cts) renderer-side disconnect detection for the crashable workspace-host utility process: MessagePort `close` is the authoritative transient signal (rejects pending requests in ~10ms even on SIGKILL), with a generation guard against stale-port clobber and a side IPC channel reserved solely for the `fatal` bit.

title: waitForReady on a pooled utility-process host must follow the latest restart-reload, not the immutable initPromise
summary: WorkspaceHostPool's waitForReady() and poisoned-entry reuse guard resolved against the immutable initPromise, so after a sleep-induced host restart the powerMonitor resume refresh() raced ahead of the reloaded host and committed stale worktree state; the fix tracks a mutable currentReadyPromise that follows each restart-reload (and clears suspendTime up front so a throwing handler can't leak it).

title: Sentry sampleRate gates error/crash capture, not traces — sampleRate < 1 silently drops that fraction of crash reports
summary: In the @sentry/electron TelemetryService, `sampleRate` controls error/crash capture (captureException/captureMessage) — NOT performance traces, which is `tracesSampleRate`. Setting `sampleRate: 0.1` silently dropped 90% of crash reports with no warning; leave it unset (defaults to 1.0).

title: Panel worktreeId is renderer-owned layout state — the backend must not emit or persist it
summary: State-hydration: a PTY/agent panel's worktreeId is renderer-owned layout state, so the backend must never re-emit it on agent:* events or win a `saved ?? backend` hydration merge (carrying it as a one-time spawn input for session-history persistence is fine).

title: Radix tooltips reopen on focus restoration when an overlay closes — solved with a two-layer defense: a global controlled-Root auto-dismiss backstop plus a per-trigger isRestoringFocus guard that suppresses the menu-close reopen
summary: A control that is both a Radix Tooltip anchor and opens a DropdownMenu/Popover/ContextMenu reopens its tooltip on close because onCloseAutoFocus restores focus to the trigger and Radix opens tooltips on focus. The actual fix is two layers covering different focus sources: (1) a global backstop in the shared Tooltip wrapper — always-controlled Root + 2500ms TOOLTIP_AUTO_DISMISS + a pointerActiveRef onFocusCapture guard — for focus-opens with no close handler (view swap, window re-activation); and (2) per-trigger suppression on AgentButton/AgentTrayButton/ProjectSwitcher/Toolbar pill — controlled open + isRestoringFocusRef armed in onCloseAutoFocus and cleared on the next pointerenter, with a pointer-vs-keyboard preventDefault split that also kills the leftover accent ring (#6119). event.detail sniffing was the failed first attempt. Layer 2 is copy-pasted four times and is the remaining candidate for a shared hook.

title: Renderer pre-injects --turbopack with no version awareness, so the main-process gate must STRIP, not just skip
summary: Dev-preview command normalization: the renderer injects --turbopack without filesystem/version context, so the main-process version gate must strip a pre-injected flag (return stripTurbopackFlag(command)) rather than skip injection — and treat an unresolvable version as "strip" (safe default).

title: Registering one fresh worktree must be add-only — syncMonitors is a full reconcile that removes every monitor absent from its array
summary: In the workspace-host, WorkspaceService.syncMonitors is a full reconcile (its array is the authoritative worktree set), so registering a single freshly-created worktree by passing a one-element array silently removes every other monitor; the fix is the add-only addNewWorktreeMonitor plus building the Worktree from inputs to kill the per-create O(N²) git worktree list.

title: Serialize mutating resource-lifecycle actions per worktree; make the auto-poll SKIP (not queue) behind a user action, and re-read the monitor after every await
summary: WorkspaceService resource-lifecycle actions (provision/teardown/status) mutate a shared WorktreeMonitor and fire from both a background poll and user requests; serialize them with a per-worktree PQueue(concurrency:1), have the auto-poll skip when the queue is busy rather than stacking, thread one AbortController so cleanup kills in-flight children, and re-read the monitor after every await since the worktree can be removed mid-command.

title: Shell-escape every substituted {{variable}} in lifecycle commands — cmd.exe needs %% too, not just /bin/sh single-quotes
summary: WorktreeLifecycleService.substituteVariables() interpolated values into shell:true commands without escaping; the non-obvious traps are that "trusted config" values still carry collaborator-controlled branch names, and that cmd.exe expands %VAR% even inside double quotes so Windows escaping must double every % to %%.

title: Hydration title merge: persisted user-renamed title must win over the live backend/OSC-derived title — but agent-identity inference wants the opposite precedence
summary: In the stateHydration builders (statePatcher.ts), merging a persisted panel snapshot with a live PTY/reconnect record must use per-field, purpose-aware precedence: the displayed title takes saved.title first (user intent), while agent-identity inference deliberately keeps the runtime title — collapsing them silently discards user renames or misclassifies agents.

title: Never relocate a pooled shell with a `cd` write — user shell hooks (zoxide/direnv/oh-my-zsh) hijack it; warm at the target cwd via node-pty's kernel chdir
summary: PtyPool/terminalSpawn trap: a pre-warmed shell cannot be safely moved by writing `cd` into it because the user's shell redefines `cd` (zoxide/direnv/chpwd) and silently lands it elsewhere; warm at the project cwd via node-pty's kernel-level `cwd` spawn option, guard the runtime repoint with a drainEpoch counter, and validate pool cwd on acquire for the cross-window singleton.

title: fix(terminal): make standard terminals robust against xterm DOM renderer pausing
summary: xterm.js 6.0 DOM renderer IntersectionObserver can silently set _isPaused=true; needs layered recovery (onWriteParsed, heartbeat, focus/visibility events). Also: terminal.open(host) is mandatory when creating fresh instances for hibernation restore, guarded by a dimension check.

title: feat(theme): circular reveal animation for theme switches
summary: Theme View-Transition reveal: committed scheme must be locked in at gesture time (clear preview state + eager-resolve-then-capture) before the async startViewTransition callback, not read late from the store. Reframed the prescribed fix to match the current store-agnostic runThemeReveal pattern and repointed paths (ThemeBrowser moved to src/components/ThemeBrowser/, proof now at line 269).

title: fix(e2e): propagate SKIP_FIRST_RUN_DIALOGS flag to sandboxed renderer
summary: Vite bakes import.meta.env at build time — env vars set only at Electron launch (E2E flags, runtime config) are always undefined in the sandboxed renderer. Expose them via preload contextBridge and check window.__VAR__ before import.meta.env.

title: fix(browser): reload page when pressing Enter on unchanged URL
summary: Electron webview loadURL() is a no-op when URL is unchanged — must call reload() explicitly for same-URL Enter-key navigation

title: fix(e2e): stabilize suite after WebContentsView migration
summary: WebContentsView migration lands 6 simultaneous bugs: each view has its own V8 context/Zustand store (broadcasts miss cached views), getAllAppWebContents iterated only active webContents, E2E getActiveAppWindow returned welcome appView due to children order, useSearchablePalette stale closure from non-memoized getItemId, default LRU=1 evicted onboarding, E2E ctx.window cached pre-switch. Audit every 'one renderer' assumption.

title: fix(persistence): capture and flush state before project view teardown
summary: WebContentsView eviction on project switch destroys webContents before beforeunload + debounced (500ms) IPC flush completes — browser/dev-preview panels (renderer-only state, no PTY anchor) vanish. Fix: capture outgoing snapshot synchronously in renderer, embed in switchProject IPC payload, main writes before swapping views.

title: fix(dock): restore dock visibility and click handlers
summary: Dock/Layout: setTimeout-based click-vs-doubleclick arbitration introduced timing races, and the registry-level moveTerminalToGrid bypassed the store wrapper's activeDockTerminalId cleanup while a getter-derived store slice was missing from useMemo deps. Repointed stale terminalStore.ts->panelStore.ts and terminalsById->panelsById, and cited the live void panelsById; forced-getter-dep pattern in ContentDock.

title: fix(e2e): resolve window staleness in nightly E2E core and online tests
summary: Playwright Electron: never cache electronApp.firstWindow() — WebContentsView project switches silently invalidate the reference, next interaction throws 'Target page/context/browser has been closed'. Use a getWindow() helper that resolves fresh at point of use.

title: feat(dev-preview): OAuth loopback flow for external auth redirects
summary: OAuth in Electron dev-preview requires RFC 8252 loopback server (not popup BrowserWindow). Google blocks Electron user-agent; popup violates RFC 8252 §8.12. Pattern: capture sessionStorage, spawn loopback server, use CDP to restore state.

title: fix(voice): handle Windows backslash paths in voice correction
summary: projectPath.split('/') in shared/ code fails on Windows — whole C:\Users\... path becomes one segment. Use split(/[/\\]/).filter(Boolean) since Node path module isn't available in renderer. Bug hit voiceCorrection.ts plus 4 renderer components.

title: fix(agent-state): prevent agent terminal getting stuck in working state
summary: ActivityMonitor CPU-high deferral loop had no upper bound — a background dev server kept agent terminals stuck in 'working' forever. Cap at MAX_CPU_HIGH_DURATION_MS (~5min). Also: emit pending state transition BEFORE checking disposed flag on teardown, and clear pattern buffers on timeout to prevent stale regex matches from blocking transitions.

title: fix(hydration): restore agent terminal panels on cold app restart
summary: PTY reconnect result 'not_found' means different things by context: cold start = PTY host not running yet (respawn), project switch = PTY genuinely gone (discard as phantom). Stale phantom-agent guard dropped all saved agent panels on every cold restart. Gate on _switchId !== undefined (only set during live switches).

title: fix(settings): project settings changes not persisting after dialog consolidation
summary: Multiple useEffect calls sharing a flag (projectIsInitialized) execute in declaration order on the same render — an init effect followed by a reset effect will suppress itself on dialog open. Consolidate into a single effect keyed on [projectId, isOpen] with conditional branches. Also: scope Zustand subscriptions to fields the form reads, not the whole slice.

title: fix(ui): recipe editor dialog overflow scrolling
summary: h-full does not establish a scrollable container in flex contexts. Use flex flex-col flex-1 min-h-0 — min-h-0 overrides the default min-height:auto that prevents flex children from shrinking.

title: fix(clone): prevent clone dialog from hanging and add cancellation support
summary: hardenedGit strips credential.helper/core.askpass/core.sshCommand — correct for background polling, but without GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 a user-initiated clone blocks indefinitely waiting for interactive prompts that can't reach an Electron context. Use separate gitForClone()/createAuthenticatedGit() for user-triggered ops (clone/push/pull) with AbortSignal + 5min hard timeout.

title: feat(git): support credentials for user-initiated git operations
summary: Split git into createHardenedGit (background polling, blanks core.askpass/credential.helper/core.sshCommand) and createAuthenticatedGit (user ops inherit keychain/gh auth/SSH agent); route by intent

title: fix(dock): prevent state corruption on docked terminal expand and project switch
summary: Five dock/grid terminal state corruption bugs: click/double-click race, no ownership check on xterm unmount, hydration overwriting dock location, and single vs grouped move path inconsistency. Use mountGeneration counter and ownership checks.

title: Windows blank terminal from fit/resize race on tab switch
summary: Windows blank xterm on tab switch: visibilitychange listener must be useLayoutEffect (not useEffect) to avoid missing render-to-effect gap; add sync missed-event recheck; do NOT gate ResizeObserver on document.visibilityState

title: E2E flakiness: fixed waits between spawns cause non-deterministic panel counts
summary: Playwright E2E: fixed T_SETTLE waits between terminal spawns go nondeterministic on Windows; clickToolbarButton without noWaitAfter:true double-dispatches from post-click network wait racing the handler

title: Windows registry PATH values contain unexpanded %VAR% references
summary: Windows registry REG_EXPAND_SZ PATH returns literal %USERPROFILE% tokens unexpanded; must call expandWindowsEnvVars before use. Node tool managers (npm AppData\Roaming, Volta, pnpm, fnm, nvm-windows) not in system PATH

title: Recipe merge priority was inverted: local shadowed in-repo instead of vice versa
summary: recipeStore mergeRecipes() priority-ordered merge: the collision filter excluded the higher-priority in-repo source instead of the lower-priority local one, hiding git-tracked team recipes. Now stamps colliding locals with shadowedBy.

title: Worktree delete dialog: untracked files incorrectly triggered uncommitted-changes warning
summary: git worktree remove blocks only on tracked changes, not untracked files; WorkspaceService must split trackedChangeCount and untrackedFileCount so delete dialog doesn't false-warn on untracked-only worktrees

title: Phantom agent terminals restored on project open due to incomplete orphan filter
summary: Phantom agent panels on project open: stateHydration orphan filter only guarded default- prefixed terminals; exited agents (hasPty false/undefined, exit 0) slipped through both orphan filter and reconnect guard

title: Panel split ratios keyed by worktree caused stale ratios for different panel pairs
summary: Panel split ratios keyed by worktree ID caused stale ratios from a previous panel pair to apply to a different pair on the same worktree; key by the specific panel pair tuple instead

title: navigator.clipboard.write() with binary PNG data crashes renderer on Linux in Electron 41
summary: navigator.clipboard.write() with binary PNG data crashes Electron 41 renderer on Linux at the native level, bypassing JS error handling; always route image clipboard writes through IPC to main process using electron.clipboard.writeImage()

title: PTY data events need adaptive batching on the MessagePort path to avoid IPC overload
summary: PTY data events forwarded 1:1 to MessagePort caused IPC overload during bulk output; adaptive PortBatcher using setImmediate for idle and 16ms intervals for bulk significantly reduces message volume

title: Browser/DevPreview panels restore stale URLs that connect to nothing after session reload
summary: Browser/DevPreview restore stale persisted browserUrl to dead dev server; clear URL on mount when no dev server configured, detect -102 ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on initial load (isInitialLoad ref) to show inline message
